index.html.title: USUCGER — U.S. Universities Council on Geotechnical Education and Research
index.html.description: USUCGER advocates for high-quality geomechanical, geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering research and education at U.S. universities. Founded 1985.

about.html.title: History & Mission — USUCGER
about.html.description: How USUCGER was founded in 1985, its mission, long-term objectives and the composition of the organization.
about.html.lead: USUCGER was born at the 1985 San Francisco International Conference on Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering, to preserve and grow research funding for the geomechanical, geotechnical and geoenvironmental community.

bylaws.html.title: By-Laws — USUCGER
bylaws.html.description: The complete USUCGER by-laws: purpose, scope, membership, functions, meetings, board of directors, officers, standing committees, amendments, dues and reporting.
bylaws.html.lead: Eleven articles governing the purpose, membership, board, officers and committees of the Council. Use the contents panel to jump to any article.

board.html.title: Board of Directors — USUCGER
board.html.description: Current USUCGER Board of Directors: officers, senior and junior board members, terms and institutions.
board.html.lead: The Board is comprised of elected members drawn from the geotechnical faculty pool across the nation — four senior and four junior directors serving staggered four-year terms, plus ex-officio members.

contact.html.title: Contact USUCGER
contact.html.description: How to reach USUCGER — webmaster, board, posting a faculty position, membership and email list questions.
contact.html.lead: Whatever you need — a job posting, a membership question, a correction to the directory, or a conference announcement — start here.

membership.html.title: Membership & Dues — USUCGER
membership.html.description: USUCGER membership categories, eligibility, dues for the 2025–2027 three-year cycle, and how to join or renew.
membership.html.lead: Participation of all people with a vested interest in geotechnical research and teaching is encouraged. Current cycle: January 2025 – December 2027 at $75 per person.

directory.html.title: Membership Directory — USUCGER
directory.html.description: Searchable directory of USUCGER members for the 2025–2027 dues cycle, with name and affiliation.
directory.html.lead: Members with dues paid for the 2025–2027 cycle. Search by name or institution, or sort any column. Not listed and think you should be? Email the webmaster.

universities.html.title: Member Universities — USUCGER
universities.html.description: USUCGER member universities and their designated contact persons.
universities.html.lead: Institutional geotechnical programs represented in USUCGER, with the contact person designated by each institution.

awards.html.title: Awards — USUCGER
awards.html.description: USUCGER awards for research, education, service and inclusion, with eligibility criteria and the complete list of past recipients.
awards.html.lead: Honoring outstanding contributions to geotechnical engineering — from early career breakthroughs to lifetime service and sustained commitment to inclusion. Four awards, twenty-nine recipients since 1998.

travel-grants.html.title: Student Travel Grants — USUCGER
travel-grants.html.description: USUCGER student travel grants of up to $1,000 for graduate and undergraduate students presenting research at conferences. Deadlines and eligibility.
travel-grants.html.lead: Up to $1,000 per student toward airfare, hotel, per diem and conference registration for students presenting accepted research, advised by a USUCGER member. Two upcoming application cycles.

research-grants.html.title: Small Research Grants — USUCGER
research-grants.html.description: USUCGER small research grants supporting geotechnical education projects, with outcomes and deliverables from funded projects.
research-grants.html.lead: USUCGER seed funding for projects that improve how geotechnical engineering is taught. Every funded project delivers free, reusable material for the whole community.

minutes.html.title: Meeting Minutes — USUCGER
minutes.html.description: Archive of USUCGER board and general membership meeting minutes from 1996 to the present.
minutes.html.lead: Board and general membership meeting minutes, 1996 to present. The annual business meeting is typically held at the ASCE Geo-Congress.

teaching-aids.html.title: Teaching Aids — USUCGER
teaching-aids.html.description: Free teaching aids for geotechnical engineering: active-learning activities, course notes, modules, lab test videos and workshop materials.
teaching-aids.html.lead: Free, classroom-ready material contributed by the USUCGER community and allied organizations — activities, modules, course notes, exam banks and lab demonstrations.

books.html.title: Books & Publications — USUCGER
books.html.description: Free full-text conference proceedings and books of geotechnical interest, including CPT, site characterization and flat dilatometer symposia.
books.html.lead: Conference proceedings released free in full text, plus a curated shelf of books of geotechnical interest.

software.html.title: Software & Data — USUCGER
software.html.description: Geotechnical software directories, open-source packages, simulators and test databases for teaching and research.
software.html.lead: Directories, open-source packages, virtual laboratories and experimental databases for geotechnical teaching and research.

videos.html.title: Videos & Webinars — USUCGER
videos.html.description: Free recorded lectures, webinar series and laboratory test videos in geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering.
videos.html.lead: Complete recorded courses, international webinar series and a full soil mechanics laboratory on video — all free.

funding-tips.html.title: Funding Tips — USUCGER
funding-tips.html.description: Pointers for early career faculty on obtaining funding for geotechnical engineering research.
funding-tips.html.lead: Practical pointers on finding and winning research funding, to help early career geotechnical faculty compete well.

positions.html.title: Academic Positions — USUCGER
positions.html.description: Open geotechnical engineering faculty positions posted by USUCGER member institutions. Free to post.
positions.html.lead: Geotechnical faculty, lecturer and research openings shared by member institutions — the page our community checks first. Posting is free for USUCGER members; listings run for one year.

industry-positions.html.title: Industry & Agency Positions — USUCGER
industry-positions.html.description: Geotechnical positions in consulting, contracting, instrumentation, software and government agencies, shared with the USUCGER community.
industry-positions.html.lead: A board for geotechnical roles outside the university — consulting, contracting, instrumentation, software and public agencies — reaching faculty and the graduate students they advise.

photos.html.title: Photo Collections — USUCGER
photos.html.description: Photo collections of geotechnical interest for teaching and presentations.
photos.html.lead: Image libraries you can draw on for lectures, presentations and course material.

conferences.html.title: Conferences — USUCGER
conferences.html.description: Upcoming geotechnical conferences shared by USUCGER members, with dates, locations and links.
conferences.html.lead: Conferences shared by USUCGER members. A more comprehensive international list is maintained by ISSMGE.

workshops.html.title: Workshops — USUCGER
workshops.html.description: USUCGER workshops for geotechnical faculty, including teaching strategies and resources workshops.
workshops.html.lead: USUCGER-organized workshops for geotechnical faculty, and the materials they produced.
